title: Content opportunities
no_connection: Connect Google Search Console in Settings to see opportunities.
no_data: Sync needs at least 2 weeks of data for most insights.
striking_help: Queries ranking position 5–20 with ≥100 impressions. Push these up with a refresh or internal links.
rising_help: Queries whose impressions grew ≥50% this 28-day window vs the previous one.
decaying_help: Pages whose clicks dropped ≥30% this window vs the previous one.
